question: The value of (45+frac{6)/(7) of 21-8}{64-(3)/(5) of (28-13)} is:
solution:
**Given:**

 (45+frac{6)/(7) of 21-8}{64-(3)/(5) of (28-13)}

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cc8f63640c17e5af9cdfc3b1e0aec219549b666eec21d379b8feb7bd6c52eb4.png] 

**Calculation:**

 (45+frac{6)/(7) of 21-8}{64-(3)/(5) of (28-13)}

⇒ (45+frac{6)/(7) of 21-8}{64-(3)/(5) of 15}

⇒ (45+18-8)/(64-9)

⇒ (55)/(55)

⇒ 1

**∴ The required answer is 1.**
